name: Account Switch Balance Transfer Acknowledgement V 06
definition: The AccountSwitchBalanceTransferAcknowledgement message is sent by the previous account servicer to the new account servicer in response to the AccountSwitchRequestBalanceTransfer message. It confirms the status of the old account and the balance of the account on closure. In the case of a negative closing balance, the old account servicer provides details of the nominated account to which payment should be made from the new account servicer.

AccountSwitchDetails.name: Account Switch Details
AccountSwitchDetails.definition: Contains information about the details of the account switch.

OldAccount.name: Old Account
OldAccount.definition: Account held at the old Account Servicer being switched to the new Account Servicer.

BalanceTransfer.name: Balance Transfer
BalanceTransfer.definition: Information that enables any payments made in connection with the fulfilment of an account switch to be reconciled by the relevant account servicer with the associated request.||Usage: In the case of a negative closing balance of the old account, and where the old account servicer wishes any payment from the new account servicer to be addressed to an alternate account, this will be specified here.

SupplementaryData.name: Supplementary Data
SupplementaryData.definition: Additional information that cannot be captured in the structured elements and/or any other specific block.
